text:
ida: Quick thread for Kairos-v1 q5k oddities on the locale grid. Symptoms different from earlier threads: 1) numerals adjacent to CJK punctuation move position after detok, 2) vertical subtitle samples show punctuation jumping to next line, 3) RTL lines with embedded ASCII digits get mirrored incorrectly (digits end up inside mirrored parens).

kenji: Can you drop a tiny repro + flags?

ida: Repro + config below. Tokenizer tkv2 locale heuristics=on. Quant: q5_k. Serving: kvcache=true, batch=5, max_seq=1024.

ida: ```
# JP sample (num + bracket)
入力: 予定は6月(23)です。
POST /v1/generate {"model":"kairos-v1","prompt":"<JA> 予定は6月(23)です。","quant":"q5_k"}
```

sara: q5k detok output (sanitized):
"予定は 6月 ( 23 ) です 。"

sara: fp16 baseline: "予定は6月(23)です。" (no spaces, original bracket/num order preserved).

ali: Vertical subtitle repro: input line with trailing punctuation ends up moving punctuation to next visual line after detok. Example input: "新幹線は東京—大阪間を走る。" -> q5k detok -> "新幹線は東京—
 大阪間を走る。" (em-dash moved to previous line or split weirdly). fp16 kept it inline.

noah: RTL + digits case: input Arabic: \u064a\u0643\u062a\u0628: (2026) -> q5k detok -> \u064a\u0643\u062a\u0628: )2026(  (parens mirrored and digits placed incorrectly inside mirrored parens).

kenji: Two quick hypotheses: (A) quant noise nudges model to emit extra small-token ids (ZWSP or space) around punctuation/numerals; (B) detok pipeline's linewrap/vertical handling stage runs after normalization in q5k path and treats punctuation as breakable.

ida: I ran a token-id diff on JP sample: ids match until the bracket token; q5k emits an extra whitespace token id (id=2048) between ideograph and numeral. Pre-detok mapping doesn't map id=2048 to U+200B, it's our internal "soft-space" token that detok converts differently under vertical-mode.

ali: Metric impact on our 800-sample subtitle set: line-break error rate 0.6% -> 3.9% (fp16 -> q5k). Numeric-bracket preservation test (500 samples) accuracy 0.998 -> 0.941.

ops-bot: Canary vela-kairos-staging job 2026-03-25T11:00 done. 7/110 locale checks failed. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/kairos-v1/q5k/4387654321/artifacts.tar.gz

sara: Action plan: (1) kenji run kernel parity with fp16 kernels on quant path to rule out execution reordering (ETA 4h), (2) try q5k-shared centroids to see if soft-space emission stabilizes (ETA 6h), (3) detok-order experiment for vertical/linewrap stage (run linewrap before normalization vs after) (ETA today), (4) collect small human-review set for JP subtitle visuals (ida) (ETA EOD).

kenji: Kicking parity jobs (job ids: parity-kairos-01, q5k-shared-kairos-02). I'll attach token-diff snippets and a short script to map "soft-space" id occurrences.

ida: helper script I used:```python
# find-softspace.py (toy)
def find_softspace(tokens):
    return [i for i,t in enumerate(tokens) if t==2048][:50]
```

noah: Hold any q5k default rollout for Kairos on Dedicated until parity results. If shared centroids show improvement, consider soft opt-in.

ida: uploading failing sample ids: kairos-q5k-4387-pt-01..05 to s3. ping me if you want manual UX screenshots. :mag_right:
